facts.text: John organized a 5K charity run in their neighborhood to support veterans and their families.

evidence.quote: I set up a 5K charity run in our neighborhood. It was all for a good cause - to help out veterans and their families.
It was hard work - getting sponsors, coordinating with the city, and spreading the word.

facts.text: John faced challenges in securing sponsors for the 5K charity run.

evidence.quote: Getting sponsors was difficult. I had to reach out to several businesses through different means, but it paid off.
We worked with a local organization that helps victims of domestic abuse. We raised awareness and funds at the event for the cause — it's unfortunate how many people suffer from it.

facts.text: John's 5K charity run included a photo of a map of the streets of downtown.

evidence.quote: The photo you shared is so powerful!
[image: a photo of a map of the streets of downtown]

facts.text: John's 5K charity run also included a photo of a sign on a door that says domestic abuse.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of a sign on a door that says domestic abuse]
We worked with a local organization that helps victims of domestic abuse.
